say:1:1720925001:1.text: They're saying Peggy disappeared by choice. That she was hiding! Can you believe that?
say:1:1720925001:1.source_cn: 太过分了！竟然把佩吉的失踪说成是主动躲藏！

say:3:1720925002:1.text: T-This can't be real. How could some street paper get anywhere near the princess' tutor? And even if they did, who would say something like this to a reporter?
say:3:1720925002:1.source_cn: 这、这应该是假的吧？普通记者怎么可能采访到佩吉公主的宫...

say:5:1720925003:1.text: Well, they know exactly what kind of story gets people worked up. Pick the nastiest angle possible, throw in a few believable details, and suddenly it sounds true enough! No wonder they're selling better than us!
say:5:1720925003:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这《赛凡纳之眼》的记者，笔杆子可真够毒的！这故事...

say:6:1720925004:1.text: ... Um, what I mean is, this kind of reporting is toxic! We need to find out who's behind it and clear Princess Peggy's name!
say:6:1720925004:1.source_cn: ……啊不！我的意思是，身为同行，他们怎么能如此颠倒黑白...

say:7:1720925005:1.text: After a quick nod, you bring Rowan up to speed—who Maska and Haria are, why the Savannah Eye has you suspicious, and how far the investigation has gotten.
say:7:1720925005:1.source_cn: 你点了点头，向罗万介绍了马斯卡和赫蒂奇，并向罗万说明了...
say:7:1720925005:1.male: After a quick nod, you bring Rowan up to speed—who Maska and Haria are, why the Savannah Eye has you suspicious, and how far the investigation has gotten.
say:7:1720925005:1.female: After a quick nod, you bring Rowan up to speed—who Maska and Haria are, why the Savannah Eye has you suspicious, and how far the investigation has gotten.

say:8:1720925006:1.text: ... So this paper has no known office, no known staff, no named sources, and even its tip mailbox is built to hide where the information goes... That's not normal!
say:8:1720925006:1.source_cn: ……也就是说，这家报社地址不明，记者和受访者不明，甚至...

choice_prompt:9:1720925006.text: ... So this paper has no known office, no known staff, no named sources, and even its tip mailbox is built to hide where the information goes... That's not normal!
choice_prompt:9:1720925006.source_cn: ……也就是说，这家报社地址不明，记者和受访者不明，甚至收取新闻线索的信箱都在防止有人追踪……这太可疑了！

say:10:1720925007:1.text: It was a smart idea. But if it worked, I didn't see any sign of it...
say:10:1720925007:1.source_cn: 引蛇出洞吗？好计策！但最近我周围没有出现过什么可疑的人……

say:11:1720925008:1.text: No strangers. No suspicious new staff. No sneaky individuals hanging about.
say:11:1720925008:1.source_cn: 不管是陌生人，还是新员工，又或者是鬼鬼祟祟的商业间谍或...

say:12:1720925009:1.text: And honestly, if all they want is to smear Peggy, they don't need to come near me for that. They can just keep printing lies.
say:12:1720925009:1.source_cn: 而且，如果他们的目的只是抹黑佩吉，完全可以继续躲在暗处...

say:13:1720925010:1.text: He's right. A paper like that doesn't need much to get people talking. Give them something juicy to gossip about, and the rest takes care of itself!
say:13:1720925010:1.source_cn: 说得也是啊，反正读者只爱看热闹，越离谱的新闻卖得越好，...

say:14:1720925011:1.text: Or maybe we're looking at this the wrong way. Forget the stories for a second. A paper is still a product. Someone has to print it, and someone has to get it onto the street.
say:14:1720925011:1.source_cn: 或者……我们换个思路。报纸终究是商品，是商品，就必然有...

say:15:1720925012:1.text: They can hide names and faces, but they can't hide every step in the chain.
say:15:1720925012:1.source_cn: 顺着这条线往上游追查，他们不可能掩盖掉所有的痕迹。

choice_prompt:16:1720925012.text: They can hide names and faces, but they can't hide every step in the chain.
choice_prompt:16:1720925012.source_cn: 顺着这条线往上游追查，他们不可能掩盖掉所有的痕迹。

say:17:1720925013:1.text: That makes sense! But I can't take that on myself right now. Between the Consortium and Peggy, I'm already stretched thin...
say:17:1720925013:1.source_cn: 有道理！可惜我现在既要处理商会内部的麻烦，又要搜寻佩吉...

choice_prompt:18:1720925013.text: That makes sense! But I can't take that on myself right now. Between the Consortium and Peggy, I'm already stretched thin...
choice_prompt:18:1720925013.source_cn: 有道理！可惜我现在既要处理商会内部的麻烦，又要搜寻佩吉的下落，有些分身乏术……

say:19:1720925014:1.text: Then I'm counting on you. Whatever you need, the Consortium will do its best to provide it!
say:19:1720925014:1.source_cn: ……那就拜托你们了！无论你们需要什么帮助，秘银商会都会...
say:19:1720925014:1.male: Then I'm counting on you. Whatever you need, the Consortium will do its best to provide it!
say:19:1720925014:1.female: Then I'm counting on you. Whatever you need, the Consortium will do its best to provide it!

choice:18:1:2.text: We'll find out who's behind it.
choice:18:1:2.male: We'll find out who's behind it.
choice:18:1:2.female: We'll find out who's behind it.

choice:16:0:1.text: We could start with the people selling it.
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 比如说，报纸的进货渠道
choice:16:0:1.male: We could start with the people selling it.
choice:16:0:1.female: We could start with the people selling it.

choice:16:1:2.text: We could find out where it's being printed.

choice:16:1:2.male: We could find out where it's being printed.
choice:16:1:2.female: We could find out where it's being printed.

choice:9:0:1.text: I also used your name in a false lead.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 我用你的假消息当了诱饵
choice:9:0:1.male: I also used your name in a false lead.
choice:9:0:1.female: I also used your name in a false lead.

choice:9:1:2.text: They might have their eyes on that list of yours.
